title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Serial_130
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FBI and military intelligence reports regarding UAP sightings, including witness statements, internal memos, and newspaper clippings.

encounters.summary: Staff Sergeant Ira L. Livingston observed 7 to 10 glowing, round objects traveling in an arc at high speed over Green Acres, Birmingham, Alabama.
encounters.entity_behavior: traveling in a definite arc, some appeared to come straight up
encounters.quote: The Discs were silent and appeared to be composed of a single light.

encounters.summary: Constable Eric Kearsey and others observed four egg-shaped, phosphorus-glowing objects in formation, followed by a single object, over Grand Falls, Newfoundland.
encounters.entity_behavior: flying in rocking motion, terrific speed
encounters.quote: I would describe as being a huge jelly-fish flash across the sky.

encounters.summary: Three mechanics observed a circular, silvery object that cut through clouds and left a long bluish-black trail.
encounters.entity_appearance: circular like a wheel, silvery, translucent
encounters.quote: It cut a straight path right through the cloud.

encounters.summary: Three witnesses observed a flame-colored, disc-shaped object with a cone-shaped after-glow trail.
encounters.entity_appearance: flame colored, disc shaped, cone-shaped trail
encounters.quote: The circle was a bright red, nearest I could describe it would be the color of a flame.

encounters.summary: A.C. Urie and his sons observed a sky-blue, oblong object with a fiery red tubular glow skimming through Snake River Canyon.
encounters.entity_appearance: sky blue, oblong, 20ft long, fiery red tubular glow
encounters.entity_behavior: skimming canyon floor, rode up and down over hills
encounters.quote: It seemed to be powered by jets emitting a fiery glow on both sides.
